newsitem.title: USA: Dow slips to downside, Nasdaq also dips.
newsitem.headline: Dow slips to downside, Nasdaq also dips.

text.p: U.S. blue chips trended lower on Thursday after spending much of the morning tacking on minute gains, then retracing from them. Nasdaq was nearly flat, hovering between positive and negative ground.
The Dow industrial average was trading off 22 points or 0.30 percent at 7335, while the Nasdaq composite was up about 0.21 point to 1410.
The long bond was trading up 9/32 at a 7.01 percent yield.
Dow component International Business Machines Corp was off 1-3/4 at 88-1/8. Salomon Brothers said it lowered the stock's rating to buy from strong buy as shares hit a target.
